status_summary: No VBA action expanding contractor processing of benefit claims, outreach to top contractors or a private-sector knowledge exchange was found since 2025-01-20. VA reduced its workforce by about 30,000 in 2025 through attrition after dropping mass-layoff plans, which is a federal staffing reduction and not a contractor shift. A $517 million claims processing contract awarded 2026-09-29 covers Veterans Health Administration community care claims, not VBA benefit claims.
